# Moxie

> Moxie is an all-in-one freelance business management platform combining CRM, invoicing, project management, time tracking, and accounting tools.

Moxie serves diverse freelancer profiles including solopreneurs, fractional leaders, creative professionals, coaches, consultants, digital marketers, graphic designers, web developers, and virtual assistants. The platform integrates with tools like QuickBooks and Plaid to streamline business operations and financial management.

## Key Topics

- CRM (Client Relationship Management)
- Project Management
- Time Tracking
- Invoicing
- Accounting
- Freelance Workflow
- Client Portal
- Business Management
- All-in-One Platform
- Contract Management
- Collaboration Tools
- Lead Management
- Solopreneur Tools
- Financial Integration
